# PKC Events

> Professional wedding planning, luxury catering, and event management services across Kerala since 2008. Certified under ISO 22000:2018 for food safety and licensed by FSSAI.

PKC Events (Pride Kitchen Caterers & Events) provides complete wedding planning, corporate event management, luxury catering, venue decoration, and hospitality solutions across Kerala.

## Main Pages
- [Home](https://pkcevents.com/): Official homepage and overview of PKC Events
- [About Us](https://pkcevents.com/about): Story, leadership team, ISO certifications, and company milestones
- [Services](https://pkcevents.com/services): Complete event management and catering services
- [Gallery](https://pkcevents.com/gallery): Portfolio and photos of luxury weddings, receptions, and celebrations
- [Blog](https://pkcevents.com/blog): Wedding planning guides, catering tips, and event inspiration
- [Contact](https://pkcevents.com/contact): Book a consultation and enquiry form

## Services
- [Premium Catering](https://pkcevents.com/services/catering): Luxury wedding, corporate, and private catering
- [Venue Booking](https://pkcevents.com/services/venue): Premium event and wedding venues in Kerala
- [Event Decoration](https://pkcevents.com/services/decoration): Custom floral, stage, and table designs
- [Photography & Video](https://pkcevents.com/services/photography): Cinematic wedding photography and film
- [Bridal Makeup](https://pkcevents.com/services/makeup): Professional bridal styling and makeup
- [Luxury Cars](https://pkcevents.com/services/cars): Premium wedding and VIP car rentals
- [Corporate Events](https://pkcevents.com/services/corporate-event): Professional corporate event management
- [Destination Weddings](https://pkcevents.com/services/destination-wedding): Complete destination wedding planning

## Target Locations
- [Event Management Thrissur](https://pkcevents.com/event-management-thrissur): Headquarters and services in Thrissur
- [Event Management Kochi](https://pkcevents.com/event-management-kochi): Luxury wedding and corporate events in Kochi
- [Kerala Events](https://pkcevents.com/): Comprehensive event coverage across all districts in Kerala
